title: 第25章 符石涨价第26章 散修和宗门弟子差距
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 收拾完院子，各自回家。
沈云和苏婉儿回房清点着巷子邻居们送的贺礼，大都是些凡俗物品，也费心了。
价值约莫能抵今日餐食的一半。
一来一往，就与邻居们建立了人情交际。
沈云初入圣城，可不想一味闭门造车，无法了解城内局势。
有利益纠葛的地方，不会平静。
他不是一个人，消息灵通能防患于未然，而不是大难临头才惊觉已晚。
这顿饭收获也不小。
戮妖大祭的影响比他想象中的要大，圣宝楼他想去看看。
接下来几日，家家户户门前都升起白幡，为即将到来的戮妖大祭做准备。
偏僻的灵农坊，以往三四天见不到执法队的影子。
现在一天见两次。
圣城执法队忙碌起来，巷子没挂白幡的两处空院子，都经过了严格缜密的搜查。
不时听到城内哪个地方，查到妖兽踪迹，大闹一场后被执法队击毙的消息。
这几天沈云也没敢跑太远，一心在家修行，养生，制符，节欲，品茶，养花，晒太阳...
日子过得充实而又闲逸。
古卷进阶之后，每天享受获得福报点翻了一倍，不能全靠婉儿伺候。
白天空下来享受的时间就多了些。
享受的同时，气血凝丝诀也不断施展，倒也不算浪费时间。
不急不躁心态好，修行速度也没慢下来多少。
沈云开始研究如何让呼吸法融入本能，在体内自行运转，做到行走坐卧皆修行。
宋子辰的入宗宴沈云也去了，随了十金的礼钱，巷子大家商量好的数额。
这是入圣宗，太少了拿不出手。
宋达也没让大家吃亏，真的在胜春楼办的宴席，算是吃回来了。
尤其是十年份灵酒的雪芝露，口感绵密，醇香美味。
沈云一杯饮下完成两点享福福报。
灵米酿根本无法与之相比，当然价格很美丽，一源石一坛。
相当的恐怖。
谁喝得起。
沈云想着等自己以后有钱了，定要喝一坛，再喝一坛。
十枚符石已经全部制作完毕，沈云暂时没选择去圣宝阁，去隔壁坊卖了两个护体符石。
“咦，今个怎么收九十金了？”
content_en:
After cleaning up the yard, we went home.
Chen Yun and Su Waner went back to their room to count the gifts sent by the neighbors in the alley. Most of them were mundane items, so they didn't bother.
The price is about half of today's meal.
As time went by, we established human relations with our neighbors.
When Shen Yun entered the Holy City for the first time, he did not want to keep working behind closed doors, unable to understand the situation in the city.
Where there are competing interests, there will be no peace.
He is not alone. He is well-informed and can take precautions before they happen, rather than being surprised when it is too late when a disaster is approaching.
This meal was quite rewarding.
The impact of the Demon Slaying Festival was greater than he imagined, and he wanted to visit the Holy Treasure Tower.
...
In the next few days, white flags were raised in front of every house in preparation for the upcoming demon-slaying festival.
In the remote Lingnongfang, the law enforcement team has not been seen for the past three or four days.
Now I see you twice a day.
The Holy City Law Enforcement Team was busy, and the two empty courtyards without white flags hanging in the alley underwent strict and meticulous searches.
From time to time, I heard news that somewhere in the city, traces of monsters were found, and they were killed by the law enforcement team after causing a scene.
Shen Yun didn't dare to run too far these days. He concentrated on practicing at home, keeping in good health, making talismans, abstaining from sex, tasting tea, growing flowers, and basking in the sun...
The days are lived fulfillingly and leisurely.
After the ancient scrolls are advanced, the daily blessing points doubled, so you can't rely solely on Wan'er to serve you.
There is more time to enjoy during the day.
While enjoying it, the Qi and Blood Silk Condensation Technique was also being used continuously, which was not a waste of time.
I am not impatient and have a good attitude, and my practice speed has not slowed down much.
Shen Yun began to study how to integrate the breathing method into his instincts and run it on its own in the body, so that he can practice it while walking, sitting or lying down.
Shen Yun also went to Song Zichen's initiation banquet, along with a gift of ten gold, the amount agreed upon by everyone in the alley.
This is the Holy Sect, there are too few to get rid of.
Song Da didn't let everyone suffer, and he really paid for the banquet held at Shengchun Tower.
Especially the 10-year-old Snow Zhilu has a dense, mellow and delicious taste.
Chen Yun drank one cup and received two blessings.
Lingmi Niang can't be compared with it at all. Of course, the price is very beautiful, one source stone, one jar.
Quite terrifying.
Who can afford to drink.
Shen Yun thought that when he got rich in the future, he would drink one jar and then another.
All ten rune stones have been made. Shen Yun did not choose to go to the Holy Treasure Pavilion for the time being. Instead, he went to the next door shop to sell two protective rune stones.
"Hey, why did you receive ninety gold today?"
title_en: Chapter 25 The price of rune stones increases Chapter 26 The gap between casual cultivators and sect disciples
